verdict.rationale: Justworks is a SaaS payroll/PEO platform, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent connectivity. The docs cover only payroll, benefits, time off, onboarding and the Xero integration, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
